title: Shaded Beige 18-Inch Wall Mount Towel Bar, Powder Coated Iron Pipe-Style Straight Bar - Pipeline Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:
Finished in Shaded Beige, stop fighting flimsy towel storage and mismatched hardware—this pipe-style towel bar delivers an authentic industrial look and dependable daily use, backed by a limited lifetime warranty, which offers sophisticated warmth in a soft, neutral tone that complements natural materials and earthy palettes.

  • Shaded Beige transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 19 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Powder coated iron provides a clean finish designed for corrosion-free, rust-free performance
  • Holds up to 10 lb for reliable everyday towel drying and storage
  • Complete your bathroom with matching pieces from the Pipeline collection

Specs

  • Product type: Towel bar (straight bar)
  • Mounting: Wall mount
  • Material: Iron
  • Center-to-center: 18 in
  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 18 x 3 x 3.3 in
  • Projection: 3.3 in
  • Bar diameter: 0.75 in
  • Weight capacity: 10 lb
  • Product weight: 2.2 lb
  • Included: Towel bar, mounting plates and all installation hardware (color coordinated mounting hardware included)
  • Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4"
  • Assembly required: False
  • Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
meta_description: 18-inch wall mount towel bar with pipe-style industrial design. Powder coated iron, 10 lb capacity, color coordinated hardware, limited lifetime warranty.
